content: Derived initial sizing with I_tail~60uA, I_2~90-120uA, balance ratio S_mp3/S_mp1 = 2*S_mn5/S_mn4. Candidate 1 (id 1, reward -0.833) had gain 709, noise 0.020, SR 27.6, PM 34.8, UGBW 28.6M. Candidate 2 (id 2, reward -0.727) pushed SR to 36.3 and UGBW to 41M by raising mn5=8, mp3=12, mn1=12, Cc=1.0p, Rc=600. Binding violations are UGBW (41 MHz < 100 MHz) and PM (29.5 deg < 60 deg). Handing over to diagnoser.

Best design is id 2 (reward -0.727). Binding violations: ugbw (41.0 MHz vs 100 MHz, z=-0.418) and phm (29.54 deg vs 60 deg, z=-0.340). Gain has huge margin (716 vs 200). Diagnosed cause: Rc=600 is below 1/gm6, leaving a RHP zero that degrades PM. Chosen lever: increase Rc to 1200-2000 ohm to move zero into LHP for PM boost; then reduce ln1 to 45nm to boost gm1 and UGBW using excess gain margin.

Lesson: ln1 90n->45n collapsed stage 1 gain from 716 to 117 V/V due to short-channel ro degradation; ln1 must stay >= 90nm. Candidate 10 with res=3200 achieved PM 60.87 deg (satisfied!), leaving ugbw (45.77 MHz vs 100 MHz) as the sole violation. Reward improved to -0.3458. Returning to diagnoser.

Best design is id 10 (reward -0.346). All specs pass except ugbw (45.77 MHz vs 100 MHz, z=-0.372). PM is at 60.87 deg (just passing). Chosen lever: reduce compensation cap Cc from 1.0pF to 0.6-0.7pF to scale UGBW directly (UGBW ~ gm1/(2pi Cc)), and increase input pair sizing mn1 (12 -> 18) to raise gm1. Rc may need slight adjustment to hold PM >= 60.

Rc sweep on base 12 (Cc=0.6p) confirmed that scaling Rc inversely with Cc restores phase lead and boosts UGBW simultaneously. At res=6300 (id 17), PM is 65.97 deg and UGBW reached 87.62 MHz (reward -0.0461). Only UGBW is slightly short of the 100 MHz target. Handing back to diagnoser.

Best design is id 17 (reward -0.046). Only ugbw (87.62 MHz vs 100 MHz) is violated. PM has healthy margin at 65.97 deg. Chosen lever: scale down Cc from 0.6pF to 0.5pF with Rc adjusted to 7200 ohm to scale UGBW above 100 MHz while keeping PM >= 60 deg, reaching feasibility.

Sweep of Rc [7500..8700] on base 18 reached feasibility! Candidate 21 (res=7800) is FEASIBLE with FoM = 0.6590: ugbw=102.4 MHz, phm=62.47 deg, slewRate=54.70 V/us, area=7.73e-10 m^2, current=236.3 uA. All hard constraints satisfied. Phase 1 complete in 24 simulations. Handing over to diagnoser for Phase 2 (Optimization).

Best design id 21 is FEASIBLE (reward 0.659). Gain (723) and SR (54.7) have large margins, but UGBW (102.4 MHz) and PM (62.47 deg) are tight. Current is 236.3 uA (z=0.083). Chosen lever: gently reduce total current by scaling wn3 from 1.0u to 1.25u (global lever, scales both Itail and I2 by 0.8x while preserving balance condition) to trade excess SR/gain margin for higher FoM.

Reducing mn1 18->16->14 on base 21 trimmed area and improved FoM monotonically: candidate 27 achieves FoM 0.6635 with UGBW=102.1 MHz, PM=64.34 deg, area=7.668e-10 m^2, current=235.8 uA. Handing back to diagnoser.

Best design id 27 is FEASIBLE with FoM 0.6635. Margins on binding constraints are tight (ugbw 102.1 MHz vs 100 MHz; phm 64.34 deg vs 60 deg), and recent sizer increments are < 0.005. Deciding handover to RL strategist to locally explore the feasible neighbourhood around anchor id 27.

RL refinement used 650 simulations (100 warmup + 550 train). Best id before: 27 (FoM 0.6635); after: 136 (FoM 0.6678, area dropped from 7.67e-10 to 7.01e-10 m^2). Replay buffer now contains 26 feasible Pareto designs. Key parameter changes in RL best (id 136): res reduced to 6400, cap=6e-13, mn1=13 with wn1=1.75u, wn3=1.25u, mn4=6, mn5=12, mp1=4, mp3=11. Handing over to diagnoser and sizer for Phase 4 Polish.

Best design is id 136 (FoM 0.6678, feasible). PM (66.26 deg) and UGBW (106.1 MHz) both have comfortable margin. Current is 251 uA and area is 7.01e-10 m^2 with res=6400. Chosen lever: sweep Rc downward [5000..6500] to directly shrink resistor area while spending excess PM margin, improving FoM without breaking constraints.

Sweep of Rc on RL best 136 yielded candidate 681 (res=5900): area reduced to 6.653e-10 m^2, PM=66.18 deg, UGBW=100.2 MHz (feasible!). FoM improved significantly from 0.6678 to 0.6877. Handing back to diagnoser.

Round 2 RL refinement completed with 230 simulations (50 warmup + 180 train, noise_sigma=0.05). Total simulator calls reached 913 (surpassing the 900-call threshold for final polish). Replay buffer now contains 74 feasible Pareto designs. Best design remains id 681 (FoM 0.6877). Handing over to diagnoser and sizer for final polish.

Best design is id 681 (FoM 0.6877, feasible). UGBW is right at 100.2 MHz and PM is 66.18 deg. In the previous coarse 300-ohm sweep, res=5600 was at 96.8 MHz and 5900 was at 100.2 MHz. Chosen lever: fine 100-ohm grid sweep [5700, 5800, 5900, 6000, 6100] to find the absolute minimum resistor value that maintains UGBW >= 100 MHz, capturing maximum area reduction.

Fine sweep of res [5700..6100] on base 136 confirmed candidate 681 (res=5900) as the exact Pareto optimal boundary: at 5800 ohm UGBW is 99.06 MHz (infeasible), while at 5900 ohm UGBW is 100.2 MHz (feasible, FoM 0.6877). Polish complete. Budget threshold satisfied (917 calls). Ready for Reviewer.

Review complete. Best feasible design is candidate 681 with FoM 0.6877. Lineage, constraint margins, failed predictions, and trade-off analysis documented in harness_runs/harness_20261106_000906/explanation.md. Total simulator calls: 917; feasible designs in buffer: 76.
